_readme: RLS suites in the rls-live-tests job (scripts/ci/run-rls-suites.mjs); format in scripts/ci/rls-lists.mjs. Entries may only be removed, never added (checked against the base commit). suites = pending: the suite runs but may not pass yet, for the stated reason; one that passes fails the job until its entry is deleted. operatorOnly = operator-run proofs that need their own disposable cluster: each must be refused at import with zero tests run, and anything else fails the job. Every suite on neither list must run all its tests and pass under CI=true.
